ValidationRule.description: A custom Rate Table row named by the PO prefix supplies the maximum tax rate; invoices may not exceed it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PO_Number__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Tax_Rate__c)), LEN(PO_Number__c) >= 3, Tax_Rate__c > NULLVALUE(VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Rate_Table__c.Fields.Rate__c, $ObjectType.Rate_Table__c.Fields.Name, UPPER(LEFT(PO_Number__c, 3))), 1) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Tax Rate exceeds the Rate Table limit for this PO prefix.
